# LBC

> > Leading British conversation - UK and world news, live talk radio, and political analysis from presenters including Nick Ferrari, James O'Brien, and Shelagh Fogarty.

LBC is a major UK news and talk radio station providing breaking news coverage, political commentary, and live caller discussions on topics ranging from UK politics and London issues to international affairs including the Trump administration, Iran conflict, and global security. The platform features prominent broadcasters analyzing stories involving key political figures like Keir Starmer, Donald Trump, and Rachel Reeves.

## Key Topics

- UK Politics
- Breaking News
- London News
- Trump Administration
- Iran Conflict
- Keir Starmer
- Talk Radio
- Military Deployment
- Energy Crisis
- Crime & Security
- Urban Planning
- Infrastructure
- MI5
- World News
- Political Analysis

## Core Navigation

- [Latest Breaking UK and World News & Opinion | LBC](https://www.lbc.co.uk/): Homepage featuring breaking UK and world news, political coverage including Trump, Iran conflict, and domestic politics
- [LBC Radio - Listen & Watch Live | LBC](https://www.lbc.co.uk/radio/): Live radio streaming hub with presenters Nick Ferrari, James O'Brien, Tom Swarbrick and full schedule

## Regional News

- [Latest London News | LBC](https://www.lbc.co.uk/news/london/): Comprehensive London news coverage including infrastructure projects, mayoral politics, and local issues

## Political Commentary & Caller Discussions

- [Caller Jewel's big American boycott to take a stand against Trump | LBC](https://www.lbc.co.uk/article/caller-jewels-big-american-boycott-to-take-a-stand-against-trump-5HjdQzw_2/): Listener discussion on Shelagh Fogarty show about American political boycotts and Trump administration

## Consumer & Lifestyle

- [Card fraud rates 'often spike around now as shoppers prepare for Christmas' | LBC](https://www.lbc.co.uk/article/6a8cdf44688343468758a2971035eeca-5HjdMxn_2/): Consumer security news covering AI-driven fraud, synthetic identity theft, and seasonal scam warnings

## Optional

- [Does Time Move Faster As We Get Older? | LBC](https://www.lbc.co.uk/article/does-time-seem-to-move-faster-as-we-age-rpZj6_2/): Mystery Hour feature exploring psychological phenomena and time perception as people age
